stories.title: Create Aesthetic C01-C02 Knowledge Assessments with Bilingual Clinical Scenario Questions
stories.description: Develop knowledge assessments for Aesthetic CU01 (Body Consultation and Analysis) and CU02 (Thermal Therapy Treatments) with clinical scenario-based questions covering assessment criteria from NOSS S960-002-3:2020. Each KA must include multiple question types (multiple-choice, short-answer, scenario-based) with integrated answer schemes and bilingual terminology matching the Aesthetic Services Bilingual Terminology Glossary.
acceptanceCriteria: aesthetic-services/C01/KA.md exists with minimum 25 questions covering all C01 Assessment Criteria, including at least 5 bilingual clinical scenarios
aesthetic-services/C02/KA.md exists with minimum 25 questions covering all C02 Assessment Criteria, including at least 5 bilingual clinical scenarios
All bilingual terms in both KA files validated against aesthetic-services/glossary-aesthetic.md with zero terminology mismatches
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/C01/KA.md (bilingual clinical scenario questions with answer schemes)
File to create: aesthetic-services/C02/KA.md (bilingual clinical scenario questions with answer schemes)
File to create: .spiral/validators/bilingual_glossary_checker.py (validates KA terminology consistency)
Test command: uv run python .spiral/validators/bilingual_glossary_checker.py --check aesthetic-services/C0{1,2}/KA.md

stories.title: Create BEV C04 Knowledge Assessment with High-Voltage Electric Drive System Questions
stories.description: Develop comprehensive knowledge assessment for BEV CU04 (Electric Drive System Diagnosis and Rectification) covering motor theory, inverter systems, gearbox operation, and power delivery diagnostics. Assessment must include diagnostic scenario questions, motor control fundamentals, troubleshooting logic, and performance metrics aligned with NOSS G452-010-3:2023 Assessment Criteria with integrated answer schemes.
acceptanceCriteria: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md exists with minimum 30 questions organized into: Motor Theory (8-10), Inverter Systems (8-10), Diagnostic Scenarios (6-8), Troubleshooting (4-6)
All questions include cross-references to corresponding C04 Related Knowledge items (RK1.1 through RK1.12 equivalent) from 00-noss-extract.md
At least 3 scenario-based diagnostic questions include detailed decision trees in answer scheme with step-by-step troubleshooting logic
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md (knowledge assessment with diagnostic scenarios and answer schemes)
Reference file: bev-diagnostic-rectification/00-noss-extract.md (C04 CoCU Related Knowledge source)
Validation command: uv run pytest tests/test_bev_c04_coverage.py::test_rk_mapping -v (validates all RK items have corresponding questions)

stories.title: Create IT-020 C01 Knowledge and Performance Materials for System Administration
stories.description: Develop foundational WIM materials for IT-020 CU01 (Computer System Fundamentals and Management) including Knowledge Points (KP-01, KP-02), Assignment Sheets (KT-01), Work Sheets (KK-01, KK-02), and Performance Assessment (PA). Content must cover system architecture, OS fundamentals, user and group management, and file permissions aligned with NOSS IT-020-3:2013 CoCU with hands-on Linux lab tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: it-computer-system/C01/KP-01.md and KP-02.md exist covering System Architecture and OS Fundamentals respectively (minimum 400 words per file)
it-computer-system/C01/KK-01.md and KK-02.md exist with step-by-step Linux system administration procedures (user creation, group management, file permissions) with safety checkpoints
it-computer-system/C01/PA.md exists with minimum 4 practical lab exercises including grading rubric aligned to C01 Work Activities, with estimated completion time per exercise
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/C01/{KP-01.md, KP-02.md, KT-01.md, KK-01.md, KK-02.md, PA.md}
Reference: noss-it020-textbook/ folder (existing knowledge base) and NOSS IT-020-3:2013 CoCU extract
Validation command: uv run pytest tests/test_it020_c01_structure.py -v (checks file structure, minimum content length, PA rubric format)
